descriptionHtml:
Bug B18 · P1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8); TFA-92597 ready for qa (R6); TFA-92579 AC 3/4 ready for qa (NEW TODAY); TFA-94745 ready for qa (draft restore) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms. TC-16/S18 (UAT 3.8, one device set to the wrong date): a phone a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow on the shared record, and the next write from a correctly clocked device lists the lines before it twice (the transcript archive trusts the device date). Which calendar day a correct device should use when its local day and the server's UTC day differ is the open question Q9 (D10); TC-16/S25 passed otherwise. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579/92584): a browser whose day is ahead writes the badge roll back to the server, and every device shows Follow-up, with the matching template and billing family (TC-01/S08, TC-20/S20a; TFA-92584 AC 8). The failing cell of TC-25/S24a is the card's NEW TODAY, which compares addedAt with the device's date (PatientCard.tsx:154-156). EFS/S28 (a)(b) restore drafts by the device date (TFA-94745); (c), an old draft put in today's box, is B13's. Review 2026-10-15 (TFA-94514): the analytics day is the device date too (pilotUsageEvents / pilotDailyRounding use localDay()): a phone 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day, and an encounter across the phone midnight is split over two days and never timed (OAT-06/S10).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S18, TC-06/S19, OAT-06/S10

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S24a Phone context a day ahead in another time zone: same badge, day, note date and 'today' as the computer

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Time-based state uses the server clock: a device with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone shows the same state as the other device (badge after the day roll, hospital day / visit number, … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Computer context on the real clock; phone context with timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu' and page.clock set one day ahead. {hospitalPatient} set to New Admission on the server's yesterday; the Nursing Home run uses {snfResident}'s visit number

When Both open the list and the chart; the phone types an encounter line and taps Generate Note & Finish once

Then Both screens show the same badge (rolled to Follow-up once), the same hospital day / visit number and the same note date. The stored transcriptDate is the server's date, and on the computer today's encounter is not listed as a prior transcript

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Scripted: badge, hospital day / visit number and note date read from both pages must be equal; the stored transcriptDate (read-only adminQuery) must equal the server's date (UAT 3.8: time-based state uses the server clock); on the computer the encounter must not appear among prior transcripts (3.6: prior transcripts show today and yesterday only). …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S24a is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92584 ready for qa

The same Hospital patient shows 'New today' on the computer but not on a phone whose clock is a day ahead, because each device decides the badge from its own clock.

Evidence: allure-results/f6b92cfc…: a phone in Pacific/Honolulu, one day ahead, vs a computer on the real clock. The Hospital card shows 'NEW TODAY' on the computer but not on the phone; headers and NH are equal. The note-date checks need Generate (not run). TC-25 knownGap TFA-92584 AC 8 (the day roll follows the device clock).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.
